prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single definitive “best” roofer for hail damage in Denver—best depends on your exact location, insurance situation, and priorities (price, speed, warranty, etc.). I can, however, help you find a highly qualified contractor and avoid scammers. A few quick options:

- If you want, tell me your zip code or neighborhood and I’ll look up top-rated local roofers and their recent reviews/certifications.

How to choose the best roofer for hail damage
1. Look for storm/hail experience and insurance-claim help
   - Ask whether they have experience with insurance claims and if they will provide documentation (photographs, scope of damage).
   - Confirm whether they will work directly with your insurer or just provide an estimate.

2. Check manufacturer certifications
   - Prefer contractors who are certified by major shingle manufacturers (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Preferred, CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster). Certification indicates training, warranty support, and higher standards.

3. Verify credentials and local presence
   - Confirm business license and local Denver/Colorado address (avoid “storm-chasers” who appear after a storm and then leave).
   - Check BBB rating, Google/Yelp reviews, Angi/HomeAdvisor listings, and ask for references from recent hail repairs.

4. Compare multiple written estimates
   - Get at least 2–3 detailed, written estimates that specify materials, brand, warranty, scope (full replacement vs. spot repair), and timeline.

5. Warranty and workmanship
   - Ask about their workmanship warranty and whether the shingles’ manufacturer warranty transfers to you. Get warranties in writing.

6. Red flags to avoid
   - High-pressure sales to sign immediately.
   - Demanding large up-front cash payments beyond a reasonable deposit.
   - No written contract or vague scope of work.
   - Refusal to provide references, proof of insurance, or licensing.

Questions to ask a roofer
- Are you licensed and insured in Colorado? Can you provide CO business registration and insurance certificates?
- Are you a certified installer for GAF/Owens Corning/CertainTeed?
- Do you have experience handling hail-damage claims? Can you help document damage for my insurance company?
- What is included in your estimate and warranty? How long will the job take?
- Can you provide references and photos of recent hail repairs in Denver?

If you give me your zip code or address area, I’ll pull up a short list (3–5) of highly rated Denver roofers that specialize in hail damage, note certifications and common complaints, and suggest who to call first.
